verdicts.reason: A: CTA button sits at the very top above the headline, so the reading order is backwards. The background photo has become a meaningless small blurry brown square. The Quillbrook bag, the hero product, has shrunk to a tiny icon at the bottom next to the logo, and the SAVE 15% badge is oversized and pulls focus. B has the same inverted CTA and the same tiny product and logo. On top of that, its body copy is jammed right under the headline and nearly touches a large, empty, blurry image block that takes up the middle third as dead space. A's headline and copy at least have more even spacing.
